summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing daily open-market repurchases under its buy-back programme announced 28 October 2026. On 06 November 2026 it bought 3,500,000 ordinary shares of US$0.50 on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of 12.9998 (range 12.9040–13.0880) and 9,600 shares in Hong Kong at HK$138.4042, all for cancellation, executed by Goldman Sachs International. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 7,559,061 shares for approximately US$130.9m, leaving issued ordinary share capital of 17,130,540,846 with no treasury shares. Watch pace of execution and any acceleration or suspension of the programme.
